components.name: Utility Boundary Header
components.description: Pairs the AEOLUS lockup with the visible monitor-only boundary.
components.html:
A
AEOLUSPoseidon · local evidence monitor
Monitor only · output unavailable
components.css: .ds-utility-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; min-height: 58px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); background: rgba(255,255,255,.98); box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(24,35,33,.06); color: var(--ink, #182321); font: 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-product-lockup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px 16px; } .ds-product-lockup > div { display: grid; } .ds-product-lockup strong { font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-product-lockup span:not(.ds-brand-mark) { color: var(--muted, #586864); font-size: .72rem; } .ds-brand-mark { display: inline-grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; background: var(--accent, #008aa6); color: #fff; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 850; } .ds-mode-boundary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; margin-right: 16px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5d2); background: var(--surface, #f7f9f8); color: var(--muted, #586864); font-size: .76rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mode-boundary i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #34715d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--success-wash, #e8f4ef); } .ds-mode-boundary strong { color: var(--ink-soft, #34433f); } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-utility-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-mode-boundary { justify-content: center; margin: 0 12px 8px; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Runs the main action in an intake, retry, or save state.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-dark, #00677c); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--accent-dark, #00677c); color: #fff; font: 750 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #004e5e; background: #005b6d; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .58; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports import, retry, attachment, and conflict-resolution actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182321); font: 750 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #008aa6); background: var(--accent-wash, #e0f3f6); color: var(--accent-ink, #004f60); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .58; }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Collects operator-entered values with an explicit label and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink-soft, #34433f); font: 700 .77rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182321); font: 400 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #586864); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .58; }

components.name: Review State Tag
components.description: Pairs an uppercase review label with a state-specific rule and wash.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--surface, #f7f9f8); color: var(--ink-soft, #34433f); font: 800 .66rem/1.15 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-uncertain { border-color: #cfaa69; background: var(--warning-wash, #fff2d7); color: #6b4300; }

components.name: Selected Event Row
components.description: Shows interval, exact peak, review state, and source in one selectable register row.
components.css: .ds-event-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px,1fr) 74px minmax(130px,1fr) minmax(100px,.72fr); align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5d2); background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182321); font: 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-event-row:hover { background: var(--surface, #f7f9f8); } .ds-event-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-event-row.ds-selected { background: var(--accent-wash, #e0f3f6); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent, #008aa6); } .ds-interval { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 3px; } .ds-interval strong, .ds-measurement { font-size: .74rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-interval small, .ds-source { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted, #586864); font-size: .68rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-tag { width: fit-content; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid #cfaa69; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--warning-wash, #fff2d7); color: #6b4300; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-event-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 7px; } .ds-measurement { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } .ds-row-tag { grid-column: 1; } .ds-source { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; text-align: right; } }

components.name: Waveform Evidence
components.description: Keeps the normalized envelope readable on narrow screens and exposes exact bucket values in a table.
components.css: .ds-waveform { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #182321); font: 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-waveform figcaption { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-waveform figcaption span { color: var(--muted, #586864); font-size: .78rem; } .ds-scroll-cue { display: none; margin: 0 0 7px; color: var(--accent-ink, #004f60); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chart-wrap { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); background: var(--surface, #f7f9f8); } .ds-chart-canvas { min-width: 0; } .ds-chart-canvas svg { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 220px; } .ds-baseline { stroke: var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-window { fill: rgba(0,138,166,.08); stroke: var(--accent-dark, #00677c); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-envelope { fill: rgba(0,138,166,.14); stroke: var(--accent, #008aa6); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-chart-canvas text { fill: var(--accent-ink, #004f60); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chart-canvas svg:focus-visible, .ds-data-table summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-data-table { margin-top: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5d2); background: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-data-table summary { padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--accent-ink, #004f60); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; } .ds-data-table > div { overflow: auto; max-height: 300px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5d2); } .ds-data-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .68rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-data-table caption { padding: 8px; color: var(--muted, #586864); text-align: left; } .ds-data-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cbd5d2); background: var(--canvas-deep, #dde5e2); color: var(--ink-soft, #34433f); text-align: right; } .ds-data-table th:first-child { text-align: left; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-scroll-cue { display: block; } .ds-chart-wrap { overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; overscroll-behavior-inline: contain; scrollbar-color: var(--accent, #008aa6) var(--canvas-deep, #dde5e2); scrollbar-gutter: stable; } .ds-chart-canvas, .ds-chart-canvas svg { min-width: 760px; } .ds-chart-canvas svg { min-height: 218px; } .ds-chart-canvas text { font-size: 16px; } }

components.css: .ds-conflict { display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d8ba82; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--warning-wash, #fff2d7); color: #694000; font: 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-comparison { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); border: 1px solid #d8ba82; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182321); } .ds-comparison > section { min-width: 0; padding: 11px; } .ds-comparison > section + section { border-left: 1px solid #d8ba82; } .ds-comparison h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-comparison dl { display: grid; gap: 7px; margin: 0; } .ds-comparison dl > div { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-comparison dt { color: var(--muted, #586864); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-comparison dd { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-conflict p { margin: 0; font-size: .7rem; } .ds-conflict-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-conflict-actions button { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #9eaeaa); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182321); font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; } .ds-conflict-actions .ds-conflict-primary { border-color: var(--accent-dark, #00677c); background: var(--accent-dark, #00677c); color: #fff; } .ds-conflict-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,138,166,.34); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-comparison { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-comparison > section + section { border-top: 1px solid #d8ba82; border-left: 0; } .ds-conflict-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-conflict-actions button { width: 100%; } }

narrative.overview: This provisional system documents the shipped operator UI. It uses daylight off-white and cool-gray surfaces, graphite text, one measured teal accent, thin solid rules, compact records, and native controls. Information stays tied to its source, state, and revision instead of becoming decorative dashboard summaries.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, readable inspection layouts with restrained hierarchy.
Teal reserved for selection, focus, and primary action.
Provenance, calibration, identifiers, and revisions remain visible.
Empty, loading, error, disabled, and conflict states use the same visual grammar as steady state.

rules.name: The Measured Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies action or evidence state; it does not fill large decorative areas.

dos: **Do** keep source identifiers, calibration limits, normalized units, and review revisions next to the evidence they qualify.
**Do** preserve text labels alongside every status color and keep exact values selectable or available in a table.
**Do** keep the 720px waveform scroll and stacked conflict behavior when composing narrower surfaces.
donts: **Don't** add decorative marine imagery, oversized metric cards, gradients, or broad accent fills to this provisional system.
**Don't** present normalized waveform values as SPL or turn candidate and human-review states into one claim.
**Don't** hide conflict, error, empty, loading, disabled, or provenance states to simplify a screen.
